summary: Make Replace-Not-Overlay a fail-closed architecture rule before section-by-section UI replacement: full-bleed route ownership is explicit, route-owned CSS cannot hide the shell or use force overrides, and the guard runs in pnpm architecture:check.
protectedReason: This change intentionally strengthens the central architecture gate so future UI replacements fail closed when they attempt overlay/hiding/force-override patterns instead of replacing the route presentation cleanly.
